versions.changelog: Keyless-first v2.0.0: the Quick-Scan now runs with NO API key and NO account — install, scan a URL, get a 0-100 GDPR/DSGVO score plus findings (trackers, cookies, consent banner, pre-consent tracking, fonts, mail/TLS). Replies in the user's language. An optional Business/Enterprise API key still unlocks full multi-page scans. Clearer scope/cache messaging; output limited to what the public web scan shows.
